newsitem.title: ITALY: Sorin says 1996 sales down, pretax rises.
newsitem.headline: Sorin says 1996 sales down, pretax rises.

text.p: Italy's bio-medical technology group Sorin Biomedica said its 1996 turnover fell to 856 billion lire from 893 billion lire in 1995, with unfavourable exchange rates costing the company 50 billion lire.

The group also said in a statement that its 1996 operating profits slipped to around 94 billion lire against 118 billion lire in 1995, while pretax profits rose to 96 billion lire from 94 billion lire in 1995.
The company is controlled by Snia Bpd which in turn is controlled by Italian industrial giant Fiat.
Earlier today, Sorin said it was selling Incstar, in which it holds a majority stake, to American Standard Cos Inc. (( -- Milan newsroom +392 66129502 ))
